intro: The Branch of Cenarius is a sacred dryad relic stolen by the vile satyr Geltharis in eastern Ashenvale. Recovering this heirloom was the dying wish of the dryad Anilia, who perished defending it from the woods' corruptors.

sections.t: A Sacred Bough Fallen to Shadow
p: Revered by the daughters of Cenarius, the Branch of Cenarius represents both the blessing of the Forest Lord and the deep connection his dryads maintain with Ashenvale. The branch was held in high regard by the dryad sisters Anilia and Illiyana until a band of corrupt satyrs ambushed them. The satyr leader, Geltharis, seized the relic and mortally wounded Anilia near the tainted ruins of eastern Ashenvale. With her dying breaths, Anilia pointed northward toward the arch where Geltharis lurks, pleading for a champion to wrest the sacred bough from his claws and restore it to dryad hands at Forest Song.
